target_customer: Community and regional banks, sponsor banks, credit unions and fintechs
problem: Third-party and fintech partner due diligence and compliance review is manual and slow.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription to regulated institutions
product_category: AI third-party risk management and compliance

founders.name: Kalyani Ramadurgam
founders.background_notes: Education not listed on YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: Extracting evidence from vendor documents and mapping to regulation with LLMs; accuracy and audit-readiness are hard parts.

defensibility.rationale: Bank buyers need trust, SOC 2 and examiner acceptance; workflow data builds lock-in.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Sponsor bank tooling vendors added compliance features; no acquisition of Kobalt found.

market_need_then: June 2023 federal guidance on third-party risk raised bank duties for fintech partners, and 2024 enforcement actions cited weak oversight.

branding.domain_note: Uses kobaltlabs.com, a suffix domain; the K spelling is distinct from Cobalt.

identity.voice_and_tone: Short confident benefit copy such as 'Let Kobalt do the reading'

brand_strength.rationale: Name collides with Kobalt Music and Cobalt companies; no brand press found.

outcome_analysis: Kobalt Labs is active with about 15 staff and an 11 million dollar Series A in December 2025 per aggregators and Seedtable. A regulatory tailwind in bank third-party oversight and bank customers such as Core Bank and MVB Bank support traction. Seed details conflict across sources and the Series A is not confirmed by a primary release in my searches.
notes: Series A figure seen on Seedtable, CB Insights and SignalBase (aggregators) with a lead named by two; no primary release found, treat as moderately verified. Seed date and amount conflict (2023-07 to 2023-10); amount null. Total raised reported 11.5M to 13M. A valuation of 55M is unconfirmed and not recorded. Competitor list empty because nothing dated near the batch was found.
